newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Market Facts Inc started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Market Facts Inc started.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said it initiated coverage of Market Facts Inc at outperform for both the intermediate and long terms, with price targets of $24 for six months and $30 for 18 months.

-- Market Facts should be able to grow by 20 percent annually as the company gains market share, benefits from new products and services and emerges from a likely consolidation in the industry, EVEREN said.
-- EVEREN's 1997 earnings estimate stands at $1.40 a share, while the 1998 estimate is $1.67 a share.
-- Market Facts is the nation's 10th largest market research firm.
-- Its shares were trading off 1/2 Wednesday at 16-5/8.
